scope: Independent coarse review at fixed desktop mounts. AABB separation can exclude collision; overlaps are candidates only.
limitations: 21 discrete mechanical poses per device, not a continuous sweep.
Other devices are parked; scenery, audience, lights, floor and support meshes are not included.
Proxy spaces are generic 1.6 x 1.35 x 1.6 m boxes, not actual occupied actors.

The targeted Wild23 check uses 153 static full-quality sculpture/form/mount combinations at single-racer centers on nodes 22 and 23; it does not certify animated, crowded, down, arbitrary future or all-map actor configurations.
